meta.ridgeInterpolation: Original A-R1 PCHIP crest elevations, connected Dirichlet crest constraints with finite cap.
meta.shoreInterpretation: Signed continuous lake margin and coast boundary solve before river sections; no post-carve attenuation.
meta.depthAllowance: Uniform 1.6 m greybox channel bed depth, continuous at graph junctions; original indicative depths retained separately.
meta.ridgeTailInterpretation: All 16 complete ridge curves impose authored lower bounds. Low spur endpoints may rise to meet surrounding terrain, rather than forcing a sink; no crown or terminal crest is released below its authored level. Actual knot deviations are exported.
